entities.summary: James Kyle Farmer is an American professional baseball infielder for the Atlanta Braves of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Los Angeles Dodgers, Cincinnati Reds, Minnesota Twins, and Colorado Rockies. The Dodgers selected him in the 2013 MLB draft, and he made his MLB debut with them in 2017.
